data.exact_reserve_text: The run-off deterioration for Syndicate 1919 relating to prior year's business was GBP 12.5m. This was mainly due to the Accident & Health class which saw an increase in exposure in the 2013 underwriting year, with relatively poor associated attritional loss experience.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Increase in exposure in the 2013 underwriting year with relatively poor associated attritional loss experience leading to run-off deterioration

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1919 recorded a gross prior-year reserve deterioration of GBP 12.5m (strengthening). The report attributes this primarily to adverse claims development in the Accident & Health class, driven by increased exposure in the 2013 underwriting year and relatively poor attritional loss experience. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 439.819m per the balance sheet.
